title: Turtles in Shinnecock Knowledge

content:
Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Snapping turtles and diamondback terrapins

The catalogue connects turtles with lunar cycles and the earth. It remembers shells used for bowls, rattles, games, and ceremonial objects, speaking about turtles collectively.1

The table names Turtle Pond and Agawam with snapping turtles, and Shinnecock Bay, Cold Springs, Heady Crick, and Moriches Bay with diamondback terrapins.1

Places named in the catalogue

Turtle Pond; Agawam; Shinnecock Bay; Cold Springs; Heady Crick; Moriches Bay.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 9. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
